tailoring.headline: E-Commerce & API Integration Specialist | SAP Commerce Cloud, Java, Spring, AI-Assisted Delivery
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years delivering large-scale e-commerce platforms (SAP Commerce Cloud/Hybris) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in Java, Spring, RESTful APIs, microservices, SQL performance tuning and CI/CD. Proven record in designing and implementing data pipelines and API integrations between PIM, ERP and MDM systems, automating workflows and leveraging AI tools for rapid development and documentation. Strong techno-functional consulting in agile international teams.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Junior Software Developer Odoo & E-Commerce
cover_en.hook: I am drawn to Notebook-Pro’s ambitious blend of hardware resale and the rollout of Odoo as a unified ERP. With over five years of experience building and integrating e-commerce platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep expertise in API-driven integration, data pipelines and automation that aligns perfectly with your vision.

bullets.label: **API Integration**
bullets.text: At Rockwell Automation I designed and exposed OCC REST Web Services and integrated SAP ERP, MDM and Profisee, automating product, inventory and pricing data flows across multiple sales channels.

bullets.label: **Data Pipelines**
bullets.text: I built robust PIM-to-Hybris pipelines using DataHub, Hotfolders and file-based processes, ensuring synchronized catalog data for global e-commerce.

bullets.label: **Automation & CI/CD**
bullets.text: I executed CI/CD deployment cycles on SAP Commerce Cloud (CCv2) and automated routine tasks, reducing release time and supporting continuous operation.

bullets.label: **Techno-Functional Consulting**
bullets.text: I gathered business requirements, wrote user stories and functional specs, and translated them into scalable SAP Commerce solutions, bridging business and IT.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe, I hold a valid German work permit and am serving notice until 15.12.2026. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how I can help build your integrated Odoo-ERP and e-commerce ecosystem.

cover_de.subject: Bewerbung als Junior Software Developer Odoo & E-Commerce
cover_de.hook: Die Kombination aus Ihrem wachsenden Hardware-Resale-Geschäft und der Einführung von Odoo reizt mich besonders. Mit über fünf Jahren Erfahrung in der Entwicklung und Integration von E-Commerce-Plattformen bei Rockwell Automation und Shell bringe ich tiefes Know-how in API-Integration, Daten-Pipelines und automatisierten Prozessen mit.

bullets.label: **API-Integration**
bullets.text: Bei Rockwell Automation habe ich OCC-REST-Web-Services entwickelt und SAP ERP, MDM sowie Profisee integriert, um Produkt-, Lager- und Preisdaten automatisiert über mehrere Vertriebskanäle zu synchronisieren.

bullets.label: **Daten-Pipelines**
bullets.text: Ich habe robuste PIM-zu-Hybris-Pipelines mit DataHub, Hotfolders und dateibasierten Prozessen aufgebaut, die eine konsistente Katalog-Synchronisation für ein globales E-Commerce gewährleisten.

bullets.label: **Automatisierung & CI/CD**
bullets.text: Ich habe CI/CD-Deployments auf der SAP Commerce Cloud (CCv2) durchgeführt und Routineaufgaben automatisiert, wodurch Release-Zeiten verkürzt und der kontinuierliche Betrieb gesichert wurden.

bullets.label: **Techno-funktionale Beratung**
bullets.text: Ich habe Geschäftsanforderungen erfasst, User-Stories und Funktionsspezifikationen erstellt und in skalierbare SAP-Commerce-Lösungen übersetzt, um die Lücke zwischen Business und IT zu schließen.

cover_de.logistics: Ich lebe in Karlsruhe, besitze eine gültige Arbeitserlaubnis für Deutschland und befinde mich bis zum 15.12.2026 in der Kündigungsfrist. Gerne bespreche ich in einem Gespräch, wie ich Ihre Systeme aufbauen kann.

tailoring.why_company: Notebook-Pro’s unique position as a multi-channel reseller of high-quality hardware, combined with its fast-growing Shopify, Amazon and eBay presence, offers an exciting challenge to create a seamless Odoo-ERP backbone. I am eager to apply my proven API-integration, data-pipeline and automation expertise to connect sales channels, inventory and pricing, while leveraging AI tools to accelerate development and deliver immediate business value.
tailoring.motivation_short: I’m excited to build a unified Odoo-ERP and e-commerce ecosystem for Notebook-Pro, leveraging my API-integration and automation expertise to deliver immediate value.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I’m Kranti, a senior SAP Commerce developer with 5+ years of API-integration and automation experience. I’m eager to help Notebook-Pro build a seamless Odoo-ERP and e-commerce platform. Could we discuss the Junior Software Developer role?
tailoring.email_subject: Application – Junior Software Developer Odoo & E-Commerce
tailoring.email_body: Dear Hiring Team, please find attached my CV and cover letter for the Junior Software Developer Odoo & E-Commerce position at Notebook-Pro. With over five years of experience delivering API-driven e-commerce solutions at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am ready to design and integrate your Odoo system and sales channels. I look forward to discussing how I can contribute.
